title: Chapter 28 New City
content:
Chapter 28 New City

Therefore, Zhong Yu doesn't have to worry about the safety of the south and east at all, and only needs to consider the safety of the north and west.

At the same time, these two aspects are also the direction of his subsequent expansion and encroachment. Those barbarian tribes are weak and ignorant, closed and closed, scattered and numerous.

It is the best target of annexation and cannibalization. The numerous tribes and endless population can provide the best resources for the development and growth of Zhongyu's territory.

After referring to the surrounding topography, Zhong Yu found that the Mengla tribe was located in the north of Luoyang. The Aisen tribe is located in the west of Luoyang. The terrain is relatively dangerous. There is a relatively dangerous mountain next to it. There is a river below the mountain. Thinking of the north and west of the mountain, only the south is not dangerous.

Zhong Yu decided to build two residences on the original site of the Aisen tribe and the Mengla tribe. These two residences will be built into small towns with a population of 1,000.

The two towns will have walls as high as five meters and guarded by about 100 people. And built three small villages with a population of 500 around, planted food to supply the consumption of these two small cities, and provided supplies along the road with Luoyang City.

The two small cities will be administratively divided into township-level administrative units, and the villages will be divided into pavilion-level. And the county-level Luoyang City dispatched officials to manage these settlements, so as to consolidate Luoyang City's control over it and deepen its influence on its rule.

However, all this is far from the future. Zhong Yu does not have so many manpower to build these two cities, and there are so many management talents to rule.

Therefore, he just left the population of the original two tribes and let them carry out the preliminary city construction first, and he will immediately carry out a new round of expansion.

Plunder enough population from the tribes in other directions to slowly fill these two small cities and the nine surrounding villages.

Some people were left to watch and supervise the construction of the city by the men of the two tribes. Zhong Yu continued with his army and set off to annex those small tribes.

Go west all the way, out of the Aisen tribe about ten miles away. Zhong Yu met the first tribe on the way of his annexation. This tribe has about fifty people, and its strength is strong. Behind the Eddra tribe alliance, it can be regarded as a relatively ordinary tribe.

There is a special phenomenon in the Edra Tribal Alliance, that is, the frontier of the tribe is close to the two major forces, and all the tribes there have a relatively large population, generally more than 1,000 people.

That's because there are wars over there all the year round, and the small tribes are either eliminated, merged, or take the initiative to join the big tribes.

In the rear, most of the tribes are dozens or hundreds of people, and basically there are no tribes with thousands of people.

There is the private plot of the leader of the Edra Tribe Alliance. Unless those small tribes are merged into the leader's tribe, they will always be small tribes. This will facilitate the leader to control them and gather the forces of those small tribes and the leader's army. The number will greatly suppress the tribes in other alliances.

As for the other big tribes, their civilizations are relatively open, and they communicate more with each other. They are fettered and restrained by each other, and there is the deterrence of their alliance leaders. Therefore, those big tribes do not dare to take action against those small tribes and annex them. They increase their strength.

However, no one could have imagined that there would be an odd number like Zhong Yu behind the Eddra Tribal Alliance, who could use the system to summon countless soldiers uncharacteristically.

Quickly annex countless tribes, and use the flesh and blood of those small tribes to develop and strengthen themselves. Zhong Yu, who has a system, can obtain countless system characters who are loyal to himself and possess various talents. And based on this, it has grown rapidly.

The small tribe seemed a little surprised when they saw Zhong Yu's army of several hundred people. They quickly gathered the tribesmen who were hunting outside and returned to the tribe. They surrounded their wooden fences that were only more than two meters high. Get up and defend.

However, they did not act too rashly and showed too obvious hostility. After all, this is in the rear of the Edson Tribal Alliance, and it is impossible to have an enemy army, and the surrounding tribes do not have such a large army. Can't afford such a good weapon.

So they guessed that this army is likely to be from the tribal alliance. As for why they came here, and they did not receive the news, it was normal.

This force may have come from the north, not from Xidan, and the surrounding tribes are closed to each other, and there is no information to communicate with each other. My own tribe didn't receive any news, it was quite normal.

Slowly, the army approached the small tribe. Stopped a mile in front of the tribe's gate, quickly lined up the army, and set up a battle formation.

For a time, looking out from the inside of the tribe, the spear formation was like a forest, the flags and flags were clothed, and all the troops, dressed in uniform black and red shirts, holding very precious iron weapons, looked majestic and murderous.

The clansmen in the tribe couldn't help but keep silent, and looked at the army outside in horror, their hearts were full of fear, and the restless emotions pervaded the tribe.

Slowly, the center of the army divided a path. A person came. The patriarch of the tribe knew this person. He was an elder of the northern Mengla tribe. When the hunting conflict occurred before, when his tribe followed the Aisen tribe and fought against the Mengla tribe, they met each other. noodle.

"Patriarch Andy, don't open the door quickly, welcome the army from the tribal alliance, and enter the tribe to rest. Do you want to be the punishment of the leader of the alliance?" , said Andy, the tribe's patriarch.

Andy saw that, the appearance of the elder, and the words he said, he couldn't help but feel relieved. At least this is not an enemy, but he is responsible for the food of the army of 300 people. To spend a lot of money, I don't know how to live the next day.

"Elder Tenny, don't worry, I will open the door of the department immediately. I saw so many troops before, and I was a little afraid of being the enemy, but now I understand that it is the army of the leader of the alliance. No wonder it is so powerful and majestic, making people feel I felt scared for a while." Patriarch Andy thought so, but a smile appeared on his face, and he said hello and flattery.

"It's good that you know. I thought you didn't want to receive the army under the leader of the alliance? Why don't you open the door quickly. If you are tired of those big men, can you afford it?" , but still do not forget to put him down. And like a loyal dog leg, he shouted at Patriarch Andy, making Patriarch Andy feel a deep hatred in his heart.

In this way, the door of the tribe opened, and Patriarch Andy took his people out of the door to welcome the entry of the army. And arranged for a few people to go to the kitchen in the tribe to prepare meals and prepare to entertain these troops, so that they can rest in the tribe in peace and not make any troubles.
